data.body:
ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (rebar-debug Phase 1). The classifier at reconcile-bridge.yml:314 — 'if echo "$push_stderr" | grep -qiE '\''non-fast-forward|rejected|fetch first'\''; then' — is SIGPIPE-fragile under the step's 'set -euo pipefail' (line 276). When grep -q matches an early line ('rejected'/'fetch first' are on stderr line 2) it exits immediately, closing the pipe; if echo has not yet finished writing the capture (large payload, or scheduler preempts echo past grep's exit on a loaded runner), echo receives SIGPIPE (exit 141). Under pipefail the pipeline's status becomes 141 (non-zero), so the 'if' takes the ELSE arm and prints 'Push failed (non-retryable, exit 1)' + exits 1 — even though the text matched and the push was a benign retryable rejection.

This EXPLAINS EVERY SYMPTOM and DISPROVES the prior leading hypothesis (empty capture): the ELSE message still shows the full stderr because $push_stderr IS populated — only the PIPELINE EXIT STATUS is poisoned, not the variable. Load-only / not-locally-reproducible because it needs grep to exit before echo's write completes (a scheduling race on an idle fast machine almost never loses). The 20000-iteration local test found 0 misclassifications because it exercised grep matching in isolation, not the echo|grep-under-pipefail SIGPIPE.

DETERMINISTIC REPRO: 'echo "$s" | grep -qiE PAT' with a 200KB payload whose match is on line 2 misclassifies 2000/2000 (echo cannot buffer 200KB before grep exits -> SIGPIPE -> pipefail). Two fixes score 0/2000: (A) pure-bash '[[ $s =~ PAT ]]' (no subprocess); (B) here-string 'grep -qiE PAT <<<"$s"' (no pipeline, so pipefail cannot be poisoned, and no upstream writer to SIGPIPE). Choosing B: it preserves the exact -iE semantics with a one-token change.

defect_legitimacy=defect. Intended behavior cited: the classifier's THEN arm is meant to route rejected/fetch-first pushes to the retry+fetch+merge path, and tests/scripts/test_reconcile_bridge_push_retry.py (guarding convergence bug 4c4f) requires a contended rejection to be retried, not failed red. Misclassifying it violates both. Single-site, low-blast-radius (the only caller is the loop itself). Well-known footgun: pipefail + early-exiting pipe consumer (grep -q/head) -> SIGPIPE 141 (BashPitfalls; Gitaly/OSS shell guidance). Fix: reconcile-bridge.yml:314 + regression test.
